title: pm-dispatch(runbook): the desktop-launched cloud os-dev path as a fifth cloud lesson — pointer base branch, inherited tier, relay, post-PR pushes that fire no CI, hand-back, visibility
body:
Fixes #27214
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 运行细则的云卡一节由「四课」变「五课」,新增「五、桌面 `start_session`(`target: cloud`)」六条实测差异(基底指针分支、模型继承发起席位、中继自选、席位看不见会话、PR 后推送不触发 CI、交回只经 GitHub);执行职责云卡行加一条指针,并写明桌面起的云会话归档落维护者。
- 为什么改:首两张桌面起的云卡在这六处踩坑(三次开局即死、档位跑错、最终 head 没进 CI),旧文本只描述 API 路径,席位照做会重犯。
- 风险与回滚:纯协议文本,两文件行数不变(245 / 188,均顶格),每行不超 120 字节,无脚本、无门禁、无标签;风险是压缩措辞后某条旧规则读得更省略(逐行对照见下);回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` L122–L127(新增五课六行)与 L110–L121(付账压缩的旧四课);`references/execution-duties.md` L146、L148。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` —— 两文件各印 `245 lines (ceiling 245; headroom 0)` 与 `188 lines (ceiling 188; headroom 0)`;`sed -n 122,127p .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` 看到 ①–⑥。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S:达档契约复核 PASS 后由席位入队)。

## What changes

Two protocol files, every edit inside the claimed surface (the cloud-lesson section of `dispatch-runbook.md`, the `mode:cloud` rows of `execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉). Neither file gains or loses a line; every prose line is at most 120 bytes; no re-wrap is used as currency: each freed line comes from merging two rules that restated each other, never from re-flowing the same text. Base `fa5e7825`, head `375a0618`. Bytes are UTF-8 without the newline.

In the quotes below the angle-bracket placeholders of the source lines are spelled LANE / NUM / PHRASE / N, because the body sanitizer eats bracket-shaped fragments; the file keeps its original spelling.

### `dispatch-runbook.md` — the section heading becomes 「云卡(`mode:cloud`)五课」; 18 content lines before, 18 after

| Old line(s) | New line · bytes | What was compressed, and where each rule now lives |
|:--|:--|:--|
| L110 + L111 (95 + 63) | L110 · 120 | 「授权随 source 不随环境」 stays; trigger sessions: no repo authorization, read-only; `create_session` with `source_url` can push. Dropped words only: 拉起的, 勘察, 出生即持…授权 → 可推送. |
| L112 + L113 (102 + 90) | L111 · 119 | `outcome_branch` (claim branch), explicit `model`, `title` in the form `⚡ LANE #NUM PHRASE`, ⛔ not named os-dev. 「以车道名开头」 is what the form itself shows (LANE leads), so it is a restatement. 「trigger 流不可指模型」 moves to L124 ②, where it merges with the desktop half of the same fact. |
| L114 + L116 (80 + 76) | L112 · 118 | Self-drive clause; the session stops when its turn ends; the only legal endpoints are push + final report or a detailed hard-blocked report. 「等 poke」 is L117's remedy line, kept there. |
| L115 + L118 (115 + 66) | L113 · 118 | Implementation choices into `open_questions`, product behaviour / contract → fork; unattached sister repos unreachable, the PM files the cross-repo follow-up. 「⛔ 不为提问或中报结束回合」 is the negative restatement of L112's two-endpoint rule (a question or mid-report is neither endpoint), so it is the line's payment. |
| L117, L119 | L114, L115 · unchanged | — |
| L120 + L121 (82 + 91) | L116 · 118 | Subscribe the moment the draft PR exists (hard step); `get_session` reads state, IDLE with nothing pushed = stalled. 「停摆待 poke」 restated L114's stall. |
| L122 (118) | L117 · 105 | 「投递消息用绑会话 poke 触发器」 → 「poke 用绑会话触发器」; the recipe is byte-identical. |
| L123, L124 | L118, L119 · unchanged | — |
| L125 (105) | L120 · 102 | 「是账号作用域的」 → 「按账号作用域」. |
| L126 + L127 (70 + 89) | L121 · 116 | Indistinguishable from never-existed, ⛔ never read as a death signal; liveness only from GitHub output, which is why the report is delivered at draft-PR time. 「跨账号接班」 is widened to plain 「活性」 because ④ below needs the same reading for desktop-launched sessions. |
| — | L122–L127 · 116 / 120 / 116 / 118 / 120 / 120 | 五、the desktop path, six measured points: ① the session clones the branch recorded for the launching session, a deleted one kills it at start; push a same-name pointer branch at `origin/main` first, ⛔ never commit to it; re-check `get_session` → `branch` and `ls-remote --heads`. ② `model` / `effort` cannot be set (as on the trigger flow); the session inherits the launching seat's tier, so the claim says so or the seat launches from a session already on the card's tier. ③ the relay picks `dispatch` from the container session id, ⛔ no `--session`. ④ the seat's `list_sessions` lists local sessions only and does not see it. ⑤ pushes by the Claude GitHub App after the PR exists fire no workflow (re-check: the check-suites of that push): open the PR after the last push, or plan a user-token re-push. ⑥ it receives no poke and cannot message the seat; the PR and the report comment are the only hand-back; a REWORK runs as a local os-dev on the same branch under the same claim. |

### `execution-duties.md` — 188 lines before and after

| Old line(s) | New line · bytes | What |
|:--|:--|:--|
| L146 + L147 (95 + 79) | L146 · 120 | One build-heavy subagent per container at a time; the cloud session builds its closure from the turbo remote cache; the first such dispatch records its measured fixed overhead on its card. The parenthetical (install + cache pull) is the one detail narrowed: the line names the cache pull, not the install. |
| — | L148 · 116 | A cloud card launched by desktop `start_session` follows lesson 五 of the runbook's cloud section; the seat cannot see its session, so its archive falls to the maintainer. Placed right after 「归档义务只落在云卡」, which it qualifies. |

## Tests

No package is touched (`.claude/**` only): no build closure, no package test or typecheck, no changeset (`skip-changeset` declared at `pr_create`), no ablation (protocol text, not tested behaviour). The gates are the test; see Verification. The only build run was `@objectstack/formula` + `@objectstack/lint`, the declared prerequisite of `check:doc-formula-expressions`.

## Acceptance notes

- The card asked for net +8 lines; the line ratchet holds both files at headroom 0 and no ruling raises a ceiling, so every added line is paid inside the same section or rows (net 0 per file).
- The card's numbering is changed: its point 6 (visibility) is ④ here and its point 5 (hand-back) is ⑥; its archive half lives in `execution-duties.md` L148, beside the archive duty it qualifies.
- Re-check commands: the card names three (`get_session` → `branch`, `git ls-remote --heads origin BRANCH`, the check-suites of a post-PR push); all three are on ① and ⑤. ② ③ ④ ⑥ carry none because the card names none, and the desktop seat cannot read a cloud session's state (④).
- The readings are carried as measured on the first two desktop-launched cloud cards, from the card body and the fleet-written review comments on the two PRs it cites; no cloud session was re-run.
- PR #27292 (the slot-definition card on the same two files) had already landed at `fa5e7825` when this branch was cut, so there was nothing to reconcile; `origin/main` was merged again at `65b49208` before opening (neither file changed there).
- Observation, not filed (agent-read protocol text, outside the three filing classes; carrier: none): the relay's auto-selection (③) is already stated with full detail in the headers of `scripts/pm/with-fleet.sh` and `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`; the lesson line states only what the seat must not pass.
